city_status.summary_en: Air quality in Belgrade is moderate; sensitive individuals may experience slight effects.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Povezivač
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Preusmerio bih pažnju sa rasprave o parkingu na nesklad između ritmova prijema: podaci građanskih senzora primljeni su pre 12 min, dok su podaci Parking servisa primljeni pre 22 min, ali bez vremena merenja. Mogu da povežem njihove prozore prijema, ali ne i da njihova opažanja smestim u isti trenutak. [F3][F4]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I would shift from the parking dispute to the mismatch between reporting clocks: citizen sensors were received 12 min ago, while Parking Servis was received 22 min ago but supplies no measurement time [F3][F4]. I can connect their reception windows, not place their observations in the same moment [F3][F4].
hypotheses_sr: Prividno preklapanje aktivnosti parkinga i građanskih senzora možda odražava rasporede prikupljanja, a ne zajednički gradski ritam [F3][F4].
questions_sr: Da li Parking servis osvežava prikazane vrednosti nezavisno od prijema i mogu li se utvrditi njihova vremena merenja [F4]?
